description: Cross-stack profile-name normalisation contract (QUAL/SEC issue 241). The Go authority (internal/profilestore/normalize.go) and the SPA pre-flight (src/components/profiles/ProfileEditorModal.tsx::nameIsDuplicate's norm()) MUST produce byte-identical output for every vector in this file. A drift in either implementation fails its language's contract test; a vector edit fails BOTH sides so the missed sync surfaces in code review.

vectors.description: passthrough for an already-normalised lowercase name
composed-é (U+00E9) is the NFKC canonical form for café
decomposed e + combining acute (U+0065 U+0301) folds to composed-é under NFKC
fullwidth digits fold to ASCII under NFKC compatibility
non-breaking space (U+00A0) folds to plain space under NFKC and is then trimmed
ligature fi (U+FB01) decomposes to 'fi' under NFKC
